content:
infra-monitor: ALERT: ap-south2 region — control-plane heartbeat gap >60s across zone-a/b/c; API ingress 5xx spike, scheduler evictions rising, GPU node health 18% healthy. DetectID: DET-1773001234. Logs:

```
[kube-apiserver] heartbeat_timeout=62s connect_errors=124
[gpu-agent] eviction: pod_restarts=112 node_drain=3
proxy: upstream 504 repeated
```
charlie_oncall: Oncall here — confirming 504s from customer health checks. Dashboard looks crashed for control-plane components. :rotating_light:
alice_sre: Seeing same. Control-plane pods in CrashLoopBackOff in zone-b, etcd latency high. Pulling etcd metrics now. :eyes:
ben_platform: Data-plane also flapping — L4 LB healthchecks failing for 3 node pools. Any config pushes recently? deploy-bot: No recent prod infra deploys in last 45m.
dana_prodeng: If control-plane is down, we should consider traffic shift. What's our nearest healthy region with spare GPU capacity?
charlie_oncall: ap-southeast1 has spare capacity (40 gpus idle) per capacity dashboard. Plan: start staged traffic shift + emergency dedicated pool boot in ap-southeast1. Can do 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% ramp.
ben_platform: Cost note: emergency pools will be billed at burst rate, and cross-region egress will increase. Dana please confirm cost ok to exceed daily threshold for outage window.
dana_prodeng: Ack, approve up to 3x daily burn for incident mitigation. Notify finance if we go longer than 2 hours.
charlie_oncall: Executing failover plan. Step 1: create emergency pool in ap-southeast1, step 2: create route rule canary 5% -> run checks, step 3: ramp if green.
charlie_oncall: Running commands now:
```
rdctl infra create-pool --region ap-southeast1 --type g4dn-xlarge --count 20 --tags emergency-1773001234
rdctl routing update --from ap-south2 --to ap-southeast1 --weight 5 --meta "incident=1773001234"
```
alice_sre: Can we add KV-cache fallback on the edge so in-flight sessions don't cold-start? If possible pin kv cache to ap-southeast1 for shifted traffic.
ben_platform: Adding prefix-KV fallback now via routing policy. Pushing change.
charlie_oncall: Canary 5% started at 1773001800 — monitoring latency/error budget. Initial synthetic checks passing for 5/5 endpoints. :white_check_mark:
alice_sre: Metrics look good for canary. No error spike seen. CPU and GPU temps normal. Proceed to 25%? :+1:
charlie_oncall: Ramping to 25% at 1773001980. Noted increased egress by ~12%.
dana_prodeng: Finance notified. Approve continued ramp.
charlie_oncall: Ramped to 75% at 1773002100. Starting final cutover to 100% in 5m if stable.
ben_platform: Started deprecating routes to ap-south2 and keeping it in read-only mode for telemetry. Also opening a ticket to provision replacement control-plane in ap-south2 once we stabilize.
charlie_oncall: FULL SHIFT COMPLETE at 1773002380 — traffic fully on ap-southeast1 emergency pool. Customer impact minimal post-canary. Creating incident postmortem and recovery runbook. Tagging SEs for outreach.
dana_prodeng: Great. Please capture cost delta and time-to-recover in postmortem. Also list any long-running mitigations.
charlie_oncall: Will add timeline, root-cause hypothesis (etcd quorum scatter + network fabric flaps), and next steps: zonal reprovision + control-plane hardening.
infra-monitor: Incident DET-1773001234 moved to state: mitigated. Follow-up: CR scheduled, oncall handoff in 2h.
```
